_readme: Controls what the Steam auto-import keeps. Used by scripts/sync-steam.mjs (the 12-hourly sync) and by src/lib/steam.ts (the site). Edit, commit, done.
_blacklistHelp: Games to never show. Add a game title (case/punctuation/trademark symbols are ignored, e.g. "Battlefield 2042") or a numeric Steam appid (e.g. 599140). Matches are exact, not partial.
_nonGameHelp: Known software/utilities that Steam files as games: 431960 Wallpaper Engine, 993090 Lossless Scaling, 1281930 tModLoader. The sync also detects software automatically through the Steam store (app type + genres like Utilities / Animation & Modeling / Design & Illustration); this list is the safety net for anything it misses.
